title: Right derived evaluation compared with derived sections on etale opens
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and U,V any opens. For every nonnegative degree n, right derived evaluation of abelian sheaves on X_et [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] at id_X, U, V and U intersection V is naturally isomorphic to derived global sections [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] on X, U, V and U intersection V, respectively, with the coefficient sheaf restricted by inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] in the latter three cases. No cover hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use the upstream natural isomorphism singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorPlusCompHomologyFunctorIso, transported through rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility, to identify each classical R^n F with H^n(RF(-[0])). The sheaf categories and coefficient category have the required injective and K-injective resolutions by the existing Grothendieck-abelian instances.

Evaluation at id_X is naturally isomorphic to global sections by Mathlib Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections and MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal. Transport this isomorphism through rightDerivedFunctorNatIso and then homology to obtain the ambient comparison.

For an arbitrary open W, upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction and ΓNatIsoSheafSections identify upperStar(W) followed by global sections with evaluation at W. The exact extension-by-zero left adjoint gives preservation of K-injective complexes by Adjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes. Thus rightDerivedFunctorCompIso identifies the total derived evaluation with R(upperStar(W)) followed by derived global sections. Exactness of upperStar gives singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorIso, moving the restriction back to sheaves before the degree-zero embedding. Whisker these natural isomorphisms with homology to obtain the open comparison.
Assemble the ambient comparison and the open comparisons specialized to U, V, and U intersection V. There is no cover hypothesis and no restriction on n beyond nonnegativity.

mathlib_searches.query: The right derived functor of evaluating an etale sheaf on an open subscheme agrees with cohomology of the pullback sheaf

lean.statement:
theorem etale_mayerVietoris_comparisons (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens) :
    Nonempty (∀ n : ℕ, (sheafToPresheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        (evaluation _ _).obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)))).rightDerived n ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0 ⋙ cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X n)) ∧
    Nonempty (∀ n : ℕ, (sheafToPresheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        (evaluation _ _).obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk U.ι))).rightDerived n ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} U.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0 ⋙
        cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} U.toScheme n)) ∧
    Nonempty (∀ n : ℕ, (sheafToPresheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        (evaluation _ _).obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk V.ι))).rightDerived n ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} V.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0 ⋙
        cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} V.toScheme n)) ∧
    Nonempty (∀ n : ℕ, (sheafToPresheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        (evaluation _ _).obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (U ⊓ V).ι))).rightDerived n ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (U ⊓ V).ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0 ⋙
        cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (U ⊓ V).toScheme n))
